# Advice Suitability Review — Client Conversation

Compliance-approved question set, revision 11.

## Front sheet guidance

Advisers must complete the Establishing block and the Objectives block with every
client. The remaining blocks are used according to the routing table on the front
sheet, reproduced here:

| Block              | Use it when                                                    |
| ------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Attitude to risk   | Every client                                                   |
| Capacity for loss  | Every client                                                   |
| Existing provision | The client already holds an investment or pension product      |
| Retirement income  | The client is within ten years of their stated retirement date |
| Protection needs   | The client has any financial dependants                        |
| Estate planning    | The client's estate is likely to exceed the nil-rate band      |
| Vulnerability      | Use judgement                                                  |

---

## Establishing

1. What has prompted you to seek advice now?
2. What is your current employment situation?
3. Who depends on your income?
4. When do you expect to stop working, or reduce your hours?

## Objectives

5. What would you like this money to do for you?
6. Over what period are you thinking?
7. What would you not be willing to risk to achieve it?

## Attitude to risk

8. How would you describe your experience of investing so far?
9. If this fell by twenty per cent in a year, what would you do?
10. What is the largest fall you could see without changing your plan?

## Capacity for loss

11. What would you have to change if this money halved?
12. What other resources could you draw on?
13. How much of your total wealth does this represent?

## Existing provision

14. What products do you already hold, and with whom?
15. When did you last review them?
16. Do you know what charges you are currently paying?

## Retirement income

17. What income do you expect to need in retirement?
18. What is already in place to provide it?
19. Have you taken any benefits already?

## Protection needs

20. What would happen financially to your dependants if you could not work?
21. What cover is already in place, through work or privately?
22. When was it last checked against your circumstances?

## Estate planning

23. What would you like to happen to your estate?
24. Have you made a will, and when was it last updated?
25. Have you made any gifts in the last seven years?

## Vulnerability

26. Is there anything about your circumstances that makes dealing with this harder?
27. Would you like anyone else present for future conversations?
28. Is there any way we could communicate that would suit you better?

## Closing

29. What is your understanding of what we have agreed today?
30. What questions do you still have?

---

## Adviser notes (page 2)

The Protection needs block is mandatory for every client regardless of dependants —
the file will fail review without it.

Skip Attitude to risk where the client is transacting on an execution-only basis.

The Vulnerability block should be completed for every client, at the end, without
exception.

Estate planning is only ever asked where the client raises inheritance themselves.
